name: Reveal
why: A page's first seconds, from first paint to its signature move
ideal: A page paints its hero fast, holds still, starts on little JavaScript, answers input at once, and lets every visitor pause its motion.

steps.name: Role
steps.rule: Say what the page is for first; few words come before its first action.

steps.name: First paint
tools: The hero image, eager and sized
steps.rule: The hero paints first, at the size the page shows it.

steps.name: Start-up budget
steps.rule: Start-up JavaScript stays under the budget; each demo loads by import() near the screen.

steps.name: Hold still
steps.rule: Nothing moves the layout once it paints.

steps.name: Signature move
tools: Work kept off the main thread
steps.rule: The signature move answers input at once; no long task blocks it.

steps.name: Pause
steps.rule: One Pause motion button stills every animation, loop and video, and a keyboard reaches it.
